title: Jerry's Map
summary: Jerry's Map is a decades-long hand-drawn cartographic project where the creator meticulously draws and continuously expands a fictional/fantasy map of their town, adding streets, buildings, parks, and imagined landmarks over many years. The map represents a unique blend of cartography, personal art, and imaginative world-building that has attracted a dedicated following.
problem_solved: Provides a creative outlet for long-term artistic expression and offers readers an imaginative escape into a lovingly crafted fictional geography.
why_valuable: It demonstrates remarkable creative persistence and dedication, showing how a simple idea evolved into a decades-long artistic practice that inspires others to pursue their own long-term creative projects.
